notes: passmark_st = CPU Single Thread Rating (cpu.userbenchmark / PassMark CPU ST).
Reference machine must be calibrated once: play the mission (or YAAB) and set budgets.
Until calibrated, verdicts are RELATIVE only (vs reference ST), not absolute FPS.
